arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Dellinger argued Title IX stands alone as the only major civil rights statute permitting retaliation claims.
Mr. Gornstein asserted administrative sanctions have never been imposed under Title IX.
Mr. Newsom clarified the scope of the available administrative remedy.
